description: EIP-2537 test vectors from ethereum/EIPs assets/eip-2537, every file except msm_G1_bls.json and msm_G2_bls.json (multi-megabyte; the MSM precompiles are still covered by mul_* and fail-msm_*). `precompile` is the address (0x0b G1ADD, 0x0c G1MSM, 0x0d G2ADD, 0x0e G2MSM, 0x0f PAIRING_CHECK, 0x10 MAP_FP_TO_G1, 0x11 MAP_FP2_TO_G2). Positives must return `expected` exactly; `fail` entries must make the precompile error.

fail.name: bls_g1mul_g1_not_in_correct_subgroup
fail.expectedError: g1 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_g1msm_g1_not_in_correct_subgroup
fail.expectedError: g1 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_g2mul_g2_not_in_correct_subgroup
fail.expectedError: g2 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_pairing_g2_not_in_correct_subgroup
fail.expectedError: g2 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_pairing_e(G1_not_in_correct_subgroup,0)
fail.expectedError: g1 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_pairing_e(0,G2_not_in_correct_subgroup)
fail.expectedError: g2 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_pairing_e(G1_not_in_correct_subgroup,G2)
fail.expectedError: g1 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_pairing_e(G1,G2_not_in_correct_subgroup)
fail.expectedError: g2 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_pairing_e(G1_not_in_correct_subgroup,-G2)=e(-G1,G2)
fail.expectedError: g1 point is not in the correct subgroup

fail.name: bls_pairing_e(G1,G2_not_in_correct_subgroup)=e(-G1,G2)
fail.expectedError: g2 point is not in the correct subgroup
